That guest book on the side table — it's pulling at me the way a locked drawer always does. Who's been here before us? What did they write? The diamond is somewhere in this house, and every detail matters. But first — oh, my heart — everyone's here. Everyone's safe. That settles something deep in my stomach I didn't know was unsettled.
